Maximum number of patrols active in one system at a time.

Base strength multiplier for punitive expedition fleets.
Minimum monthly tracker increase while any AI cores are installed in player colonies. No gain without AI cores.

Monthly credits per weighted AI core for the Draconis intelligence payment arrangement.
Heavy armaments export bonus earned by defeating the expedition. 0.25 = +25%%.
Minimum days between AI core industry disruptions on player colonies.

Security team cost as a multiple of the targeted industry's build cost.
